title: Anda Bhuna (Egg Bhuna)
equip: Saucepan, small deep nonstick pan, gas stove

steps.x: Cover the eggs with water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then simmer 9 min. Cool in cold water for 5 min and peel. Skip this if you already have prepped boiled eggs.
Heat the oil in the pan on medium heat. Add the onion, garlic and ginger and sauté for 6 min until golden. Don't let the onion burn.
Add the tomatoes, all the spices, salt and the water. Turn the heat to high and cook for 6 min, stirring often.
Keep stirring on high heat for 3 min until the masala dries out and gathers in the centre of the pan.
Optionally make 4 shallow cuts in each egg. Add them to the pan and stir for 2 min until coated in masala.
Top with the coriander and serve straight away.

notes: Total time excludes boiling the eggs (about 15 min with cooling) unless you've prepped them.
Spicy: plate the child's portion first, or use Kashmiri chilli powder for colour with little heat.
If the tomatoes taste too sour, add 0.25 tsp sugar while the masala cooks.
Serve with rice, parathas, toast or alongside a chicken curry.
Storage: fridge up to 2 days in an airtight box. Reheat on the stove or in the microwave with a splash of water. The eggs go rubbery if reheated for too long.
Meal prep: it makes 2 portions, so double it for 4 lunch portions. The masala keeps well, so you can add the eggs fresh.
